MATCH (a:PlantItem {tag: 'E-1-1'}), (b:PlantItem {tag: 'CHV-2-1'})
MATCH p = shortestPath((a)-[:line_to*]->(b))
RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | coalesce(n.tag, n.piping_component_name)] AS tags,
       [n IN nodes(p) | head([l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['Equipment','Valve','ProcessInstrumentationFunction','ActuatingFunction','UnresolvedOffPageConnector']]) ] AS types

MATCH (d:plm__PCA_100029511)
WHERE d.document_id = 'alfalaval-m3' AND d.plm__PCA_100029521 CONTAINS 'Max. design pressure'
RETURN d.plm__PCA_100029522 AS "Maximum Design Pressure"

MATCH (d)
WHERE d.document_id = 'swagelok-ms-01-176'
  AND any(l IN labels(d) WHERE l IN ['plm__PCA_100029511','plm__PCA_100029508','plm__PCA_100029510','plm__PCA_100029505'])
  AND (toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521,'')) CONTAINS 'working pressure'
       OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521,'')) CONTAINS 'pressure rating'
       OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521,'')) CONTAINS 'maximum back pressure'
       OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029522,'')) CONTAINS 'psig'
       OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029522,'')) CONTAINS 'bar)')
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029516]->(s)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029520]->(c)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029514]->(f)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029525]->(sec)
RETURN d.plm__PCA_100029521 AS label,
       d.plm__PCA_100029522 AS value,
       coalesce(s.rdfs__label,'') AS subject,
       coalesce(c.rdfs__label,'') AS caseLabel,
       coalesce(f.plm__PCA_100029522,'') AS footnote,
       coalesce(sec.plm__PCA_100029521,'') AS sourceTitle,
       sec.schema__pageStart AS page
LIMIT 200

MATCH (d:plm__PCA_100029510)
WHERE d.document_id = 'gorman-rupp-0700286'
  AND (
    toLower(d.plm__PCA_100029521) CONTAINS 'maximum operating pressure' OR
    toLower(d.plm__PCA_100029521) CONTAINS 'maximum casing pressure'
  )
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029520]->(c:case)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029525]->(s:source)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029514]->(f:datum)
RETURN d.plm__PCA_100029521 AS Label, d.plm__PCA_100029522 AS Value, c.rdfs__label AS CaseLabel, f.plm__PCA_100029522 AS FootnoteText, s.plm__PCA_100029521 AS SourceTitle, s.dct__description AS SourceDescription, s.schema__pageStart AS Page
LIMIT 200

{"tool": "drawing", "question": "What is the flow path from E-1-1 to CHV-2-1? List all items connected along the path in order, with their tags and types."}

Tool result:
{"answer": "The flow path from E-1-1 to CHV-2-1 is E-1-1 (Equipment), CHV-1-2 (Equipment), P-1-3 (Equipment), P-2-1 (Equipment), P-2-2 (Valve), and CHV-2-1 (Valve).", "not_present": false}
{"tool": "datasheet", "tag": "E-1-1", "question": "What is the maximum allowable pressure of this item?"}

Tool result:
Datasheet alfalaval-m3, pages [2, 1]:
The maximum allowable pressure is the maximum design pressure: 10.3 barg (150 psig) under the ASME pressure vessel code, or 16.0 barg (232 psig) under the PED code — both for the FG frame [p. 2]. Extended pressure and temperature rating may be available on request [p. 2].
{"tool": "datasheet", "tag": "CHV-1-2", "question": "What is the maximum allowable pressure of this item?"}

Tool result:
Datasheet swagelok-ms-01-176, pages [3, 12, 1, 14]:
The maximum allowable pressure (working pressure) of these check valves is up to 6000 psig (413 bar), which applies to the CH4 and CH8 series in 316 stainless steel at 10 to 100°F (-12 to 37°C) [p. 1, p. 3].

But the limit depends heavily on which series (variant), body material, and temperature you have — always check the rating for your exact case:

- CH4, CH8, 316 SS, 10–100°F (-12–37°C): 6000 psig (413 bar); note: "Pressure ratings may be limited by the end connection. See Dimensions, page 12." [p. 3]
- CH4, CH8, 316 SS, 300°F (148°C): 4660 psig (321 bar) [p. 3]
- CH16, 316 SS, 250°F (121°C): 4080 psig (281 bar) [p. 3]
- C series 12C, 16C, brass, 200°F (93°C): 1300 psig (89.5 bar) [p. 3]
- 2C, 4C, 6C, 8C, CA, CP, CPA, 316 SS, -10 to 100°F (-23 to 37°C): 3000 psig (206 bar); drops to 2325 psig (160 bar) at 300°F (148°C), and 2185 psig (150 bar) at 375°F (190°C). Brass is rated only up to 250°F (121°C): 2405 psig (165 bar) [p. 3, table "Pressure-Temperature Ratings"]

For the CH series, the end connection can lower the limit: the Dimensions table on page 12 lists pressure ratings per end connection at 100°F (37°C), e.g. Female NPT 1/4 in. = 6000 psig (413 bar), but Female NPT 1 in. = 4400 psig, and Male VCR fitting 3/4 in. = 3700 psig.

"Maximum back pressure" (the pressure allowed on the outlet side, at 70°F/20°C) is a separate value per series in Table 1 on page 3 — e.g. CH4/CH8: 6000 psig (413 bar), CH16: 5000 psig (344 bar), CA/4CPA/8CPA adjustable: 3000 psig (206 bar), 2C/4C: 1000 psig (68.9 bar) — the latter rising to 3000 psig (206 bar) for valves with 25 psi (1.8 bar) cracking pressure. For CH16, back pressure may also be limited by the end connection [p. 3].

If you tell me which series, material, and temperature you are working with, I can point you to the exact figure. The facts here do not give a single rating for all variants.
{"tool": "datasheet", "tag": "P-1-3", "question": "What is the maximum allowable pressure of this item?"}

Tool result:
Datasheet gorman-rupp-0700286, pages [1, 2]:
The maximum allowable pressure is a maximum operating pressure of 250 psi (1723 kPa), valid at liquid temperatures up to 100°F (37°C), based on system component limitations [p. 1]. The pump casing itself can take more: maximum casing pressure 266 psi (1834 kPa) [p. 1]. For applications exceeding these pressure and/or temperature limits, consult the factory [p. 1].

The performance curve on page 2 also lists a maximum operating pressure of 250 (psi) for the VGH2 1/2C-B-1 curve with water and 60 Hz supply, with a note to "specify plumbing accordingly" [p. 2].

Note: there's also a maximum temperature limit for the liquid pumped by the seal of 160°F (71°C), but that's a temperature, not a pressure limit [p. 1].
